facts.text: Central District hosts the Langston Hughes Performing Arts Institute, a former synagogue now a landmark for Black artists.
The Northwest African American Museum in Central District showcases exhibits and talks spotlighting Pacific Northwest’s Black and African diaspora.
Central Cinema offers a mix of classics and cult favorites, paired with beer and bar food, making it a quirky local spot.
Ethiopian café Selam, Mexican taquerias Carmelo’s and Taco Chuki’s, and Southern-style Ezell’s Chicken create a global flavor mosaic in the neighborhood.
Sacro Bosco serves wood‑fired pizzas and curated wines in a bright space that also houses Temple Pastries bakery.
Raised Doughnuts and Mitten Sweets provide unique desserts like mochi doughnuts and yuzu cheesecake, adding sweet surprises to the area.
